glosses: in particular, a tribal village; (historical) aldeia

examples.text: Ele é o único sobrevivente na aldeia.
examples.en: He's the only survivor in the village.

examples.text: Visitei a aldeia em que ele nasceu.
examples.en: I visited the village he was born in.

examples.text: A aldeia tinha mais de mil habitantes.
examples.en: The village had more than a thousand residents.

examples.text: Existe uma aldeia entre o rio e a colina.
examples.en: There is a village between the river and the hill.

examples.text: Dava menos de um quilômetro a distância da aldeia ao correio.
examples.en: It was less than one kilometer to the village post office.
